note: Two forested campgrounds set apart from the falls and picnic areas: the North Campground holds the electric sites, the South Campground sits in a valley between two ridges. Showers and drinking water run from Memorial Day weekend to Oct. 1, weather permitting. --Claude
summary: Copper Falls camping page and DNR campground map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 55 sites (North 32 with 28 electric; South 23 non-electric incl. 4 walk-in), showers/flush toilets, vault toilets, dump, reservations required; winter sites 1-6 confirmed. Pin ~540 m north of the North Campground; re-pin proposed. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PIN: 46.3717,-90.6430 -> 46.3673,-90.6461 (centre of the OpenStreetMap North Campground polygon, the electric loop the old note meant; the campground road is visible on Esri imagery). The stored point is about 540 m NNE, by the park office/concession buildings. The South Campground is a further ~850 m south (46.3597,-90.6444); one entrance road serves both, so no split.
HOOKUPS: 28 electric sites per the DNR; amperage is not stated on any DNR page I could read, so hookups.electric stays unset.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The Bad River meanders 100-150 m west of the North Campground through forest, in its valley; no site is on it.
SEASON (manual, not overwritten): year-round with six plowed electric sites (1-6) in winter confirmed; showers/drinking water Memorial Day weekend to Oct. 1 (in the note).

UNCONFIRMED: stored $25-40 (GoingToCamp fee panel, 2026-10-10) and site lengths ('All campsite details, including site lengths, are available on the reservation website') are on wisconsin.goingtocamp.com (refuses, not retried).
